Now let me summarize what I've found. Let me create a comprehensive list:

h15.

Based on my analysis of the repository, memo visibility enforcement is implemented in more than three distinct server surfaces. Here are the enforcement sites I found:

**Memo Service (API) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go**
- `checkMemoReadAccess()` function (lines 39-68) enforces visibility when reading individual memos
- `ListMemos()` function (lines 218-227) applies visibility filters for listing

**User Service Stats — server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go**
- `ListAllUserStatsRequest()` function (lines 83-92) filters memos by visibility
- `GetUserStats()` function (lines 217-221) enforces visibility when viewing user statistics

**Frontend Service (Sitemap) — server/router/frontend/frontend.go**
- `getSitemapXML()` function (lines 149-151) restricts sitemap to public memos only

**File Server — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go**
- `checkAttachmentPermission()` function (lines 649-704) enforces visibility when serving attachment files

**Memo Comments Service — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go**
- `CreateMemoComment()` function (lines 33-43) enforces visibility before allowing comments
- `ListMemoComments()` function (lines 158-161) applies visibility filters to comments

**Reactions Service — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go**
- `ListMemoReactions()` function (lines 30-41) enforces visibility when listing reactions
- `UpsertMemoReaction()` function (lines 82-85) enforces visibility before allowing reactions

**Memo Attachment Service — server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go**
- `ListMemoAttachments()` function (lines 213-225) enforces visibility when listing attachments

**RSS Service — server/router/rss/rss.go**
- `GetExploreRSS()` function (lines 90) restricts RSS feeds to public memos
- `GetUserRSS()` function (lines 141) restricts user RSS to public memos

**Memo Relation Service — server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go**
- `ListMemoRelations()` function (lines 107-112) applies visibility filters to memo relations

**User Notifications Service — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go**
- `canViewerAccessMemo()` function (lines 302-316) enforces visibility when rendering notification payloads
